title: The Pink Suit Law Student Costume
intro: The pink suit is the only costume that works at a party on Saturday and in a meeting on Monday. A hot pink two piece skirt suit, fitted and buttoned properly, pink patent stilettos, a top handle satchel, a classic pearl necklace and a pink velvet headband doing the heavy lifting. Tuck a baby pink laptop sleeve under your arm and the joke lands without a word. If you are going to be the law student in pink, commit to the suit, then wear the blazer with jeans all winter.

items.name: Hot pink two piece skirt suit (blazer and pencil skirt)
Pink patent pointed toe stiletto pumps
